records.text: Werner Stuber, Swiss equestrian, died on February 7, 1957, aged 57.
records.textJa: Werner Stuber（Swiss equestrian）が1957年2月7日に57歳で死去した。

records.text: Fritz Thiedemann, German equestrian, died on January 8, 2000, aged 81.
records.textJa: Fritz Thiedemann（German equestrian）が2000年1月8日に81歳で死去した。

records.eventLabel: equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – team jumping
records.text: On August 17, 2016, equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – team jumping took place at National Equestrian Center, won by Philippe Rozier.
records.textJa: 2016年8月17日、equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – team jumpingが行われた（National Equestrian Center）。勝者はPhilippe Rozier。

records.eventLabel: equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – individual jumping
records.text: On August 19, 2016, equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – individual jumping took place at Markopoulo Olympic Equestrian Centre, won by Nick Skelton.
records.textJa: 2016年8月19日、equestrian at the 2016 Summer Olympics – individual jumpingが行われた（Markopoulo Olympic Equestrian Centre）。勝者はNick Skelton。

records.text: On September 13, 2021, the 2011 European Show Jumping Championship began in Madrid.
records.textJa: 2021年9月13日、2011 European Show Jumping Championshipが始まった（Madrid）。

records.text: On September 18, 2021, the 2011 European Show Jumping Championship ended in Madrid.
records.textJa: 2021年9月18日、2011 European Show Jumping Championshipが終わった（Madrid）。
